---
title: "Descriptive Analysis"
---

::: {.callout-note title="Teaching outline"}
This chapter introduces the workflow. Apply it with the reviewed variable map and study protocol; the analysis templates are components, not a validated turnkey pipeline.
:::


# Start here before regression

Always inspect:

- cohort size
- missingness
- distributions
- implausible values
- category frequencies
- outcome prevalence
- exposure prevalence

Do not fit the final model until these checks are complete.
